keyword: will artemis land on the moon

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission launches in April 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA conducted an April 1 launch of the Artemis II mission'; R2: 'The launch was successful and occurred on schedule... April 1'; R3: 'The Artemis II mission is expected to take off... on Wednesday, April 1'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the launch occurred on April 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission will not land on the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Artemis II mission will not land on the moon'; R2: 'The Artemis II crew will not land on the moon'; R3: 'While Artemis II will not land on the moon'; R4: 'Although the mission will not land astronauts on the Moon'; R5: Implied in mission description as flyby without landing.
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly state or clearly imply no landing for Artemis II.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission will orbit the Moon.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R2: 'crewed mission to lunar orbit' but 'fly at altitudes between 6,000 and 9,000 kilometers above'; R4: 'will not enter lunar orbit'; R1: 'circle the moon'; R3: 'journey around the moon'
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict: R2 loosely calls it lunar orbit, R4 explicitly denies entering lunar orbit; others describe circling/flyby ambiguously.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission will test systems with a crew.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm Artemis II as first crewed test of systems/Orion/SLS.
